title: quercus douglasii var. ransomii
intro: Quercus douglasii var. ransomii, commonly known as Douglas' oak, is a variety of evergreen tree that belongs to the Quercus genus. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Quercus douglasii var. ransomii include wound healing, anti-diarrheal, and anti-cancer activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the scope of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
